what: A card row wider than the stage slides left one step (card width + gap) every 3 seconds with .6s cubic-bezier(.4,.4,0,1), looping endlessly — a second copy of the set sits behind it, and on reaching the first copied card it jumps back to the start with no transition. Pauses while hovered. Prev and next buttons advance one step, then the 3 seconds are counted again. The play button stops and restarts the loop, and the pause/play icon inside it swaps. Pauses when off-screen.

options.hover: 0 means it won’t pause on hover
options.view: Turns only when the panel is visible beyond this share, default 0 (if even slightly visible) — e.g. .5 so it does not advance when only the panel edge shows
options.[data-fx-part=prev] · [data-fx-part=next: (if any) prev·next·play buttons — put .fx-sc-pause·.fx-sc-play indicators inside the toggle and only one shows depending on state

use:

note: Rebuilt the Product sd-carousel (data-animate-duration 600 · data-interval-duration 3000 · data-hover-stop) with the same behavior — Product runtime code is not used

from.where: index.html .sp-carousel (work and voice card row, original sd-carousel animate 600ms, interval 3000ms, hover-stop, max-length 7, card 999px + 1px gap). The transition curve is an ease-in-out close to the previous-transition progress measured with motion-probe (.04 .11 .19 .35 .51 .73 .85 .94 .97 1)
